info.title: PackProof API
info.description: The contract for PackProof's versioned merchant, Connect, and claims-review API. Transaction, session, and handoff identifiers never confer merchant authority. Responses inventory evidence, hashes, and layered assurance; they do not authenticate items, prove custody, decide fraud or fault, or guarantee a dispute outcome. Internal persistence, support, secret, and forensic-only fields are excluded.

post.summary: Create or replay a page-declared passport-draft handoff
post.description: Browser-safe endpoint for the PackProof Button. The publishable installation key identifies an integration but is not a secret or merchant authorization. PackProof requires an exact allowlisted HTTPS Origin, binds idempotency to the integration, origin, and canonical request, and caps the result at PAGE_DECLARED trust. This endpoint cannot assert payment, create or bind an external order, or finalize evidence.

post.summary: Create or replay a merchant transaction
post.description: Creates one immutable PackProof transaction identifier. An exact Idempotency-Key replay returns the original result; a key reused with different input is rejected.

get.description: Returns only transactions owned by the authenticated credential's organization, ordered by server creation time and PackProof transaction ID.

post.summary: Create or replay a participant invitation
post.description: Issues a short-lived, one-time claim capability for a participant reference already declared on this merchant transaction. The external reference is a non-authorizing merchant label: only a successful claim made by an authenticated PackProof user binds an actor to the role. The plaintext token is returned only in this response and is stored by PackProof only as a digest.

Binds the authenticated PackProof user to the invitation's transaction role after validating the one-time claim token. Firebase App Check augments, but never replaces, Firebase user identity. Possession of a claim link alone provides no transaction read authority.

post.summary: Create or replay an actor-bound evidence session
post.description: Creates a bounded capture authorization for an already claimed participant: transaction, actor, role, purpose, artifact types, capture profile, expiry, and redemption count are fixed by the server. Creation authorizes acquisition only; it does not establish evidence authenticity, physical correspondence, or finalization.

get.description: Returns only an evidence session owned by the authenticated merchant organization. An evidence-session identifier or redemption link does not grant this read authority.

post.description: Validates Firebase user identity, App Check, actor binding, expiry, cancellation, redemption limit, and the one-time token before issuing a legacy native capture-session nonce. Exact operation-key retries replay the same capture authorization; unrelated replays are rejected.
Revokes an unfinalized evidence session for the authenticated merchant organization and removes any remaining redemption capability. Cancellation does not erase already captured records.

get.description: Returns the organization-authorized inventory of captured evidence metadata, hashes, and layered assurance. Storage paths, uploader identities, and forensic-only fields are excluded. This is not item authentication or a dispute outcome.
Returns participant-visible timeline summaries. Internal actor identifiers are excluded.

Organizes terms, protocol completeness, hashed evidence, shipment/return records, and timeline for authorized human review. Documentation categories are filing labels only. The package never states fraud, fault, authenticity, custody, or a card-network, carrier, marketplace, or payment disposition.

Returns the canonical PackProof Passport aggregation for a transaction and binds a stable Passport identity the first time eligibility passes. The Passport inventories source-attributed records and integrity bindings. It does not authenticate items, prove custody, decide fraud or fault, or guarantee a dispute outcome. Absence of evidence does not make a Passport inauthentic. Returns 409 PASSPORT_NOT_READY when eligibility fails.

post.description: Stores an immutable canonical JSON snapshot of the live Passport for later PDF export. Native evidence remains the source.

get.summary: Retrieve a live PackProof Passport by Passport id
get.description: Accepts a ppt_ resource id or a PP-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX display id. Authorization is still required. The QR or verification URL does not grant access.

post.summary: Create a presentation-only Passport PDF export
post.description: Renders a frozen snapshot to PDF. presentationOnly remains true. Native artifacts and manifests remain the source records. HMAC-SHA256 service authentication is not a digital signature.

post.summary: Create or replay a presentation dossier
post.description: Generates a presentation-only PDF dossier from retained originals and manifests. The dossier does not replace native evidence. A short-lived download URL is included and expires after 15 minutes.

get.summary: Retrieve a presentation dossier and short-lived URL

get.description: Returns merchant-asserted carrier and tracking context. This is not carrier custody proof.

post.summary: Associate tracking after packing and seal evidence
post.description: Records merchant-asserted carrier tracking only after a server-finalized packing video and high-resolution seal reference are present with no recorded byte-integrity mismatch. Tracking association is not a custody, delivery, or fraud determination.

get.description: Returns merchant-asserted inbound delivery context linked to a server-finalized arrival photograph. This is not carrier custody proof, receipt authentication, or a completed buyer review.

post.summary: Associate receiver arrival after delivery evidence
post.description: Records merchant-asserted inbound delivery context only after a server-finalized arrival photograph is present with no recorded byte-integrity mismatch. Optional tracking is compared to any barcode observed during capture. This does not complete the transaction or decide a dispute.

Creates a REQUESTED return passport after both participants are claimed and shipment has been recorded. The other participant still authorizes in the native app. This does not approve a refund or decide fault.

post.summary: Associate return tracking after packing and seal evidence
post.description: Records merchant-asserted return carrier tracking only after a server-finalized return packing video and high-resolution return seal reference are present with no recorded byte-integrity mismatch. Tracking association is not a custody, refund, or fraud determination.

post.summary: Create or replay an order-bound Connect session
post.description: Creates a seven-day order-bound capture session for an API client bound to an active PackProof API integration. This is merchant-server attested order binding, not the page-declared Button path. The capture URL and token are returned only here and on exact idempotent replay. Send the capture URL to the seller; do not log the token. After the seller redeems the handoff and packing evidence is server-finalized, PackProof posts packproof.evidence.finalized to callbackUrl.

get.summary: List Connect sessions for an external order
get.description: Returns Connect sessions for the authenticated integration or organization that match the partner's externalOrderId. Use this when the original session identifier was not retained. The handoff token is never returned.
Returns session status and the bound transaction identifier after seller redemption. PENDING_REDEMPTION sessions past expiresAt are returned as EXPIRED. The handoff token is never returned on GET.

post.description: Revokes the one-time capture handoff for a session that is still PENDING_REDEMPTION or EXPIRED. Redeemed sessions cannot be cancelled. Exact actor replay after a successful cancel returns the cancelled session.

PackProof POSTs this event to the HTTPS callbackUrl supplied when the Connect session was created. Verify X-PackProof-Signature against the exact raw body and X-PackProof-Timestamp before parsing JSON. Deduplicate X-PackProof-Delivery. The payload reports digital-evidence status only; it is not a physical-authenticity, fraud, custody, or legal verdict. dossierUrl is freshly signed for each delivery attempt and expires in 15 minutes.

parameters.name: X-PackProof-Timestamp
parameters.description: Unix time in seconds used as the HMAC prefix.

parameters.name: X-PackProof-Signature
parameters.description: HMAC-SHA256 of timestamp.exactRawBody, hex-encoded with a v1= prefix.

parameters.name: X-PackProof-Delivery
parameters.description: Stable delivery identifier. Treat repeats as the same attempt lifecycle.

200.description: The partner accepted the delivery. Any 2xx is treated as success.

4XX.description: The partner rejected the delivery. PackProof retries with bounded exponential backoff.

merchantApiKey.description: Environment-scoped merchant credential. The secret is shown once and is never stored in plaintext by PackProof.

firebaseUserBearer.description: A current Firebase ID token identifying the PackProof user. Claim and redemption links do not replace user authentication.

firebaseAppCheck.name: X-Firebase-AppCheck
firebaseAppCheck.description: A valid Firebase App Check token. It supplies application context and augments, but does not replace, user identity or resource authorization.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: A unique key for this logical mutation. Reuse only for an exact retry.

PublishableKey.name: publishableKey
PublishableKey.description: Public PackProof Button installation identifier. It is safe to place in browser code and grants no merchant or order authority.

Origin.name: Origin
Origin.description: Browser-supplied exact HTTPS origin. Origin allowlisting constrains browser embedding but is not treated as cryptographic merchant authentication.

AccessibleTransactionId.name: transactionId
AccessibleTransactionId.description: A merchant transaction identifier or an accepted Connect-origin transaction identifier. Possession of the identifier does not grant access.

ExternalOrderIdQuery.name: externalOrderId
ExternalOrderIdQuery.description: The partner's order identifier supplied when the Connect session was created.

PassportId.name: passportId
PassportId.description: A PackProof Passport resource id (ppt_) or display id (PP-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX). Possession of the identifier does not grant access.

PassportFrameworkQuery.name: framework
PassportFrameworkQuery.description: Optional receiving-party workflow identifier used only to fill reviewContext. Not stored on Passport identity.

PassportCategoryQuery.name: category
PassportCategoryQuery.description: Optional dispute category used only with framework to fill reviewContext.

XRequestId.description: Correlation identifier for logs and support.

RateLimitLimit.description: Maximum requests in the active operation window.

RateLimitRemaining.description: Requests remaining in the active operation window.

RateLimitReset.description: Unix time in seconds when the active window resets.

IdempotentReplayed.description: True when the original idempotent result was returned.

url.description: HTTPS listing-image reference only; it is not captured or finalized PackProof evidence.

productUrl.description: HTTPS URL whose origin must exactly match the calling Origin header.

reviewUrl.description: Short-lived bearer handoff URL. Do not log, persist, or send it to third parties.

CaptureInstructions.description: No capture authorization or bearer link is issued by transaction creation. A separately authenticated capture-session endpoint is required before capture can begin.

ParticipantClaim.description: Public participant-claim projection. External references, actor identifiers, token digests, and internal ownership fields are intentionally excluded.

externalReference.description: Must exactly match the merchant-declared participant reference for this role. It remains non-authorizing and is not returned by the API.

token.description: Short-lived one-time claim capability. PackProof persists only its digest.

claimUrl.description: Short-lived handoff URL. The URL alone grants no read access and does not replace Firebase user authentication or App Check.

EvidenceSession.description: Public actor- and purpose-bound acquisition authorization. It is not a claim of evidence authenticity or server finalization. Internal actor IDs, organization ownership, and token digests are excluded.

redemptionUrl.description: Short-lived native-app handoff. Possession alone grants no session read or redemption authority.

operationKey.description: Stable client operation identity for an exact redemption retry.

CaptureAttestation.description: A bounded nonce for the existing native capture pipeline. It proves successful authorization issuance, not that evidence was captured, uploaded, or finalized.

AssuranceAssessment.description: Layered observation metadata. physicalCorrespondence is always NOT_AVAILABLE and businessLegalRelevance is always REVIEW_REQUIRED in this release. These dimensions are not a MATCH/NON_MATCH verdict.

ShippingTrackerObservation.description: Open-source tracking-number identification and canonical observation hash. This is checksum and courier identification from published tracking-number data, not live carrier custody.

shippingTracker.description: Present when a shipping barcode was observed at capture. Null for artifacts without an open-source tracker observation.

Shipment.description: Merchant-asserted tracking context. It is not carrier custody proof.

EvidenceReport.description: A presentation-only dossier. Native evidence and manifests remain the source records.

PackProofPassport.description: Canonical PackProof Passport. Web/API JSON is the Passport. PDF is a presentation export of a frozen snapshot. It does not authenticate items, prove custody, decide fraud or fault, or guarantee a dispute outcome.

enum: PackProof record integrity verified with recorded limitations

ConnectSessionStatus.description: PENDING_REDEMPTION is the issued handoff. READY_FOR_CAPTURE means the seller redeemed the session and a transaction exists. EXPIRED is computed on read when PENDING_REDEMPTION is past expiresAt. CANCELLED is an explicit merchant revoke of an unredeemed session.

Delivery.description: Merchant-asserted inbound delivery context linked to an arrival photograph. It is not carrier custody proof.

EvidenceFinalizedCallback.description: Inbound Connect callback. Verify the HMAC over the exact raw body before parsing. dossierUrl is added at delivery time and expires after 15 minutes.

PublicCommerceHandoffCreated.description: A new short-lived page-declared passport-draft handoff was created.

PublicCommerceHandoffReplayed.description: The original short-lived result for an exact browser idempotency replay.

TransactionReplayed.description: The original result for an exact idempotent replay.

ParticipantInvitationCreated.description: A participant claim capability was issued for a declared merchant reference.

ParticipantInvitationReplayed.description: The original invitation and token for an exact idempotent retry.

ParticipantClaimed.description: The authenticated PackProof user was bound to the declared transaction role.

ParticipantClaimReplayed.description: The same authenticated actor replayed an already completed claim.

EvidenceSessionCreated.description: A bounded evidence session and one-time redemption capability were created.

EvidenceSessionReplayed.description: The original evidence session and token for an exact idempotent retry.

EvidenceSessionRedeemed.description: The actor-bound capability was redeemed and a native capture-session nonce was issued.

EvidenceSessionRedemptionReplayed.description: An exact operation-key retry returned the original native capture-session nonce.

EvidenceSessionCancelled.description: The evidence session is cancelled, or an exact cancellation retry returned the cancelled session.

ReviewPackageRetrieved.description: The claims-review evidence package. It organizes documentation; it does not decide a claim.

PassportRetrieved.description: The live PackProof Passport aggregation. It does not authenticate items, prove custody, decide fraud or fault, or guarantee a dispute outcome.

PassportSnapshotCreated.description: An immutable Passport snapshot was stored.

PassportSnapshotReplayed.description: The original Passport snapshot for an exact idempotent retry.

PassportExportCreated.description: A presentation-only Passport PDF was generated from a frozen snapshot.

PassportExportReplayed.description: The original Passport PDF export for an exact idempotent retry.

EvidenceReportReplayed.description: The original presentation dossier for an exact idempotent retry.

EvidenceReportRetrieved.description: The presentation dossier metadata and a freshly signed short-lived URL.

ShipmentCreated.description: Tracking was associated after packing and seal evidence.

ShipmentReplayed.description: The original shipment association for an exact idempotent retry.

DeliveryCreated.description: Inbound delivery was associated after arrival evidence.

DeliveryReplayed.description: The original delivery association for an exact idempotent retry.

ReturnListRetrieved.description: Return passports for the authorized transaction.

ReturnCreated.description: A return passport was requested or return tracking was associated.

ReturnReplayed.description: The original return passport for an exact idempotent retry.

ConnectSessionCreated.description: A new order-bound Connect session was created.

ConnectSessionReplayed.description: The original Connect session for an exact idempotent retry.

ConnectSessionListRetrieved.description: Connect sessions matching the partner external order identifier.

ConnectSessionCancelled.description: The unredeemed Connect session was cancelled, or the original cancelled session was returned.

Error404.description: The resource was not found in the authenticated organization.

Error409.description: The request conflicts with idempotency or resource state.

Error429.description: The operation rate limit was exceeded.

Error500.description: An internal failure occurred without exposing implementation details.
